question: The Indira Gandhi Canal originates at Harike barrage in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Punjab**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Indira Gandhi Canal**, one of the largest irrigation projects in India, originates from the **Harike Barrage**, located in the **state of Punjab**.
 
• The **Harike Barrage** is situated at the confluence of two major rivers, the **Sutlej** and the **Beas**, which are tributaries of the Indus River system.
 
• This canal was constructed to provide water to the arid regions of **Rajasthan**, particularly to the districts of Jaisalmer and Barmer, which face acute water scarcity.
 
• The Indira Gandhi Canal spans a length of approximately **650 km**, making it one of the longest canals in India.
 
• The canal plays a crucial role in transforming the desert landscape of Rajasthan by supporting agriculture, drinking water needs, and economic activities in the region.
